infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Svastha uses the camera to scan meals and lab reports. Photos are processed in memory and never stored.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Svastha accesses photos you pick to scan a meal or lab report.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Svastha creates a dedicated Svastha calendar to sync your routines, meals, medicines, and retest date.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Unlock Svastha with Face ID to protect your personal health data.
